purpose: Check in a bounded two-dimensional meridional surrogate whether one real sampled AngleSource fan can contain leakage and guided exit, then replay each emitted inclination with a separate SingleRay.

lowerFan.prediction: The upper fan's five cases in reverse order with every side and transverse coordinate reflected. The offset axis accounts for the pinned sampler's half-open angular interval.

criticalFan.prediction: The first sampled ray reaches the sidewall close to critical incidence. Record the real callbacks. Withhold any validated whole-fan classification for this case.

scope: The source problem provides index and tilt facts but no guide or source dimensions. This study uses one homogeneous rectangular Glass body as a finite meridional slice. It makes no claim about skew rays, continuous acceptance, cladding, loss or power transmission, and makes no public authoring change.
